title: Cylinder
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a single circle with its center at coordinates [0.0104, 0.0104] and a radius of 0.0104 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scale factor of 0.0208 to the entire sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the previously defined Euler angles and translating it using the specified translation vector. To create the three-dimensional model, extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This extrusion will form a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylinder will be a length of 0.02083333333333333 units, a width of 0.02083333333333333 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the base of the cylinder
r = r.center(0.0104, 0.0104).circle(0.0104)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is stored in 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0104, 0.0104)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0104)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0.0104, 0.0) \
     .radiusArc((-0.0104, 0.0), -0.0104) \
     .radiusArc((0.0104, 0.0), -0.0104) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
